build_timm_backbone: build a TIMM backbone model with a specified base name and output levels for Detectron2
build_p67_timm_fpn_backbone: build a TIMM FPN backbone with P6 and P7 top levels for object detection
build_p35_timm_fpn_backbone: build a TIMM FPN backbone using only P3 to P5 feature levels
create_timm_resnet: create a TIMM ResNet model with a given variant and output indices
freeze_module: freeze a PyTorch module parameters and convert batch norm to frozen batch norm
